policies.wifi: Free WiFi available for all customers
policies.parking: Street parking available, validated parking at City Garage
policies.reservations: No reservations needed on weekdays, walk-ins welcome
policies.allergies: Please inform staff about allergies, we accommodate dietary restrictions

faqs.question: Do you have vegan options?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer oat milk, almond milk, and soy milk. Our avocado toast is vegan.

faqs.question: Is there WiFi?
faqs.answer: Yes, free WiFi is available for all customers. Password: CoffeeTime2024

faqs.question: Can I work here with my laptop?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We have plenty of outlets and comfortable seating. Many people use our space for work.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: We partner with UberEats and DoorDash for delivery within 3 miles.
